## Three bets for Q4
layout: cards-3
kicker: The plan
subtitle: Each bet has one owner and one number to hit
label1: Monthly invoicing
footer1: "Target: 40 accounts by December"
label2: Same-day delivery
footer2: "Target: 95% same-day in the north"
label3: Recycled reporting
footer3: "Target: 12 accounts opted in"
takeaway: Together the three bets add about 9% to Q4 revenue

### body1
- One invoice per account each month
- Pilot with ten accounts in October
- All accounts in December

### body2
- Same-day service in the north region
- Two new evening routes
- Every order tracked online

### body3
- Recycled content on each invoice
- A quarterly summary per account

## How an order moves today
layout: process-4
kicker: Operations
step1: Order
text1: Placed online or by phone; most now arrive through the web form.
step2: Pick
text2: Picked from the nearest warehouse within two hours.
step3: Ship
text3: Shipped on the next route, same-day where the route allows.
step4: Invoice
text4: Invoiced on delivery today, and monthly from Q4.

## The monthly invoicing pilot
layout: process-5
kicker: Bet 1
subtitle: Ten accounts, one quarter, then a decision
step1: Select
text1: Choose ten accounts that asked for it.
step2: Set up
text2: Move their billing to one monthly run.
step3: Run
text3: Bill October orders on November 1.
step4: Review
text4: Ask each account what worked.
step5: Expand
text5: Offer it to every account in December.
